deep.reconstruction:
This page is the opening of Riemann's own manuscript (Reinschrift/draft) of the introduction to 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen', published in Crelle's Journal 54 (1857). It contains no derivations, only the author's summary of contents.

Content, paraphrased: The Abelian functions are treated by the method whose principles were laid down in his Inaugural Dissertation (1851) and presented in slightly altered form in three earlier papers of 'this Journal'. In the manuscript the paper numbers are left blank. In print these are the three preparatory notes in Crelle 54: on functions of a complex variable, on Dirichlet's principle and on Analysis situs.

The first Abtheilung treats a system of 'gleichverzweigte' algebraic functions (functions on one and the same Riemann surface) and their integrals, as far as theta series are not needed:
- §§1-5: determination of these functions by their discontinuities (singularities). This is the existence theory via the Dirichlet principle and the Riemann(-Roch) count.
- §§6-10: their rational expressions in two variables s, z linked by an algebraic equation F(s,z)=0.
- §§11-16: transformation of these expressions by rational substitutions.

The concept that emerges is a 'Klasse' of algebraic equations that can be transformed into one another by rational substitutions, i.e. a birational equivalence class. In modern terms this is an isomorphism class of compact Riemann surfaces, or of algebraic function fields. The transformation of such an equation into equations of lowest degree in its class (§16) is said to be useful elsewhere too. The page breaks off: 'Diese Abtheilung behandelt endlich zur Vorbereitung der folgenden ...'.

Comparison with the printed text: print reads '§. 11-13' and '(§. 13)' where the manuscript has '§. 11-16' and '(§. 16)'. Print also says 'in den drei vorhergehenden Aufsätzen' instead of 'in den drei Aufsätzen No. [blank] dieses Journals'. In print the remaining sections (§§14-16) are explicitly the preparatory part; the draft had not yet fixed that numbering.

The deletions and insertions show Riemann's editing:
- 'Klasse' is inserted.
- 'durch' is struck twice.
- 'ihrer Klasse' is inserted after 'niedrigsten Grades'.
- 'enthält' is replaced by 'behandelt'.
errors: No mathematical errors: the page contains no computations.
Section numbering differs from the published version (§11-16/§16 here versus §11-13/§13 in Crelle 54). This reflects a later reorganisation, not an error.

results.what: Programmatic statement: algebraic functions on a Riemann surface determined by their singularities (Dirichlet principle method)
Concept of a class of algebraic equations equivalent under rational substitutions
results.modern_name: Birational equivalence class of algebraic curves / isomorphism class of compact Riemann surfaces (function fields)

results.what: Reduction of an equation to equations of lowest degree within its class
results.modern_name: Normal forms / minimal-degree plane models of curves of genus p (Riemann's count of moduli 3p-3 is in the same section)

deep.surprise_reason: This is the manuscript of the published introduction to Riemann's 1857 Abelian functions paper. The text is essentially identical to the print. The only novelty is minor philology: the draft section numbering (§11-16 vs §11-13), the blank for the journal paper numbers, and the visible insertions of 'Klasse' and 'ihrer Klasse'.
transcription_corrections: Struck 'durch' after 'von': the image shows 'von [-durch-] algebraischen Gleichungen'. The machine transcription is correct, but the inserted word 'Klasse' is written above 'einer' as a superscript insertion.
'ihrer Klasse' is an interlinear insertion between 'niedrigsten Grades' and '(§. 16)'. Its placement is correct.

'[-enthält-] behandelt': the deleted word is underlined/struck at line start and 'behandelt' is written beside it. This is consistent with the printed text 'Diese Abtheilung behandelt endlich im §. 14-16 zur Vorbereitung der folgenden'.
'No.' followed by a blank space: Riemann left the paper numbers unfilled. In print this became 'in den drei vorhergehenden Aufsätzen'.
Folio number '129' appears in a later hand at the right margin.
